title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — November 09, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.3)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C5.3 (Peaked November 09, 2026 at 14:26 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: M1.1 (Peaked November 08, 2026 at 18:27 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 651 km/s (Fast)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.00)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Hold onto something! 🌬🌞👀

Several active regions and a clear sunspot group are visible across the Sun, with especially bright structured emission in the lower-central disk.

Images: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195, 284, 171, 304, 131, 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
